headline: Japanese Yen Surges as Investors Seek Safe-Haven Assets
summary: The Japanese yen rallied sharply as financial market investors fled to safe-haven assets amid heightened global economic and political uncertainty.
why: The Japanese yen is one of the world's primary reserve currencies and historically functions as a safe-haven asset during market volatility.

impacts.name: Japanese Yen
impacts.why: Increased demand for safe-haven currencies during market volatility drives up the value of the yen.

why_moved: The yen surged as investors shifted capital into safe-haven assets amidst broad market volatility and economic uncertainty.
